sections.name: body
sections.value:
# Event followers: price receives separately from decisions

The F261 lapse follower uses subscribe_live(EventFilter::kinds(...)) and decides lapses serially, without a new timer or per-seat task. A kind filter is applied AFTER the broadcast receiver has received/cloned the Event. Price the added follower as one daemon-wide receiver times TOTAL event throughput and payload bytes, even though unrelated events trigger no SQL. A bounded ring prevents an unbounded replay backlog; it does not make this copying free.

Keep direct per-edge reads separate from inherited work. One eligible lapse adds registry.get and one exact-process start read. The existing F212 path can enumerate matching controls, list every pane for composer/cursor verification, and sort holdings/resolve projects for notices. One indexed read or one capture is not proof that the complete path is O(1), or that one port call equals one SQLite statement.

ProcLiveness normally reads macOS proc_pidinfo/Linux procfs, and answers an absent PID in-process. An existing unreadable process or failed local-time conversion can use the existing counted absolute-path /bin/ps fallback. No NEW launch site is not the same as no launch during actual remedy: existing control typing, CLI restart initialization and registration retain their costs. Lag/drop recovery and startup attachment are correctness questions; a missed restart being conservative is not proof of a successful recovery.

Evidence at PR311 head 2e36d6a887a4ec4bcf251762d604a10f7f125a33: ROUND1 performance PASS-WITH-NOTES, pr-freeze FINAL/CI5-of-5. CI run44868597764 job136737799086 selected artifact14691959975; 24 relevant JUnit cases passed (16 auth recovery, two no-ps liveness, six spawn-site sensors). No local Rust compile or mutation run; macOS liveness implementation unchanged and inspected only.

Live BEFORE only: deployed commit653f90ef96/PID22838, UTC2026-11-21T05:06:14.779533Z to05:06:34.813812Z, monotonic20.034019s. Total2732->2732, all20 ops flat, fallback0; CPU+4.36s=21.76% one core; RSS122688->128832KiB. Separate20s machine sample352.8 launches/s,334.3/s sampled, no daemon children sampled. Machine window overlaps review quick checks and other fleet work; it is not PR attribution. AFTER belongs to the authorized deploy owner and should include natural recovery's inherited control/registration launch deltas. No bounce, live lapse, restart, install, dependency link, or build performed; collectors finished and tree clean.

magicWand: encode a read-only cost-receipt command exposing receive/payload/drop counts alongside monotonic CPU/RSS/spawn evidence, and run the busy whole-machine sampler in a separately labelled window.

difficulties: dependency-free harness boot reports ready=false; quick checks exit1 for missing locked tools/dependencies and incompatible ambient Biome, despite native/SDK passes. Exact-head CI is distinct from a local gate pass. Copilot memory voting is unavailable; the governed role note is the durable handoff. No repair of a C25 review tree.
